# The compiler, end to end

One run against a throwaway copy of `tests/fixtures/paperclip-model`
(the fixture companies `demo` and `nested`). Reproduce it with:

```
python scripts/demo_paperclip_company.py
```

## compile every company that opted in (the CI gate)

```
$ bin/paperclip-company --root tests/fixtures/paperclip-model --all --check
demo: compiled — 2 agents, 2 routines
  nested: compiled — 3 agents, 3 routines
paperclip-company --all: 2/2 compiled
```

## see the crew

```
$ bin/paperclip-company --root tests/fixtures/paperclip-model --show --company demo
demo — Demo Company
  boundary paperclip-boundary@1.0 · contract contract-2026.11.1 (a7baab409dce…)

agents (2)
  ops-credit-analyst               Analyst                  ops.credit       → —
  ops-credit-credit-officer        Credit officer           ops.credit       → —

  demo.flow                        demo.flow (industries/demo/flows/demo.flow.yaml)

routines (2)

  demo.flow.s2-assess          L3  supervised  pending  DEMO-PEND-01

skills (1) · evals (1)
  skill  skill-a                      industries/demo/pack/skills/skill-a
  eval   eval-a                       industries/demo/evals/eval-a
```

## render the sheet a reviewer reads

```
$ bin/paperclip-company --root tests/fixtures/paperclip-model --render --company demo --out $DEMO/crew.md
paperclip-company: rendered $DEMO/crew.md — 2 agents, 2 routines
```

## write templates and leave a record

```
$ bin/paperclip-company --root tests/fixtures/paperclip-model --all --out-dir $DEMO/out --record
demo: compiled — 2 agents, 2 routines
  nested: compiled — 3 agents, 3 routines
paperclip-company --all: 2/2 compiled
```

## measure it

```
$ bin/paperclip-company --root tests/fixtures/paperclip-model --metrics
companies 2 (opted in 2): compiled 2, skipped 0, failed 0
agents 5 · routines 5 (autonomous 3, supervised 2, pending 2)
```

## prove the alert can fire

```
$ bin/paperclip-company --root tests/fixtures/paperclip-model --drill
drill: A2 fired — drill.r1 is autonomous on an unreviewed rule — OK
```

## What the run shows

The gate compiles only the companies that declared `paperclip:
compile: true`; `--show` and `--record` are the human and the
evidence views; `--metrics` is the same state as numbers; and the
drill proves the critical alert fires. Nothing here needs Paperclip
running — that is the adapter's job (PC1-03, #262), not the
compiler's.
